definitions.gloss: inexperienced; having no experience; no prior experience
definitions.explanation: Having no prior experience in a particular field, job, or activity. Very commonly seen in job listings to indicate that applicants without experience are welcome.

examples.japanese: {未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}{歓迎|かんげい}。
examples.english: No experience necessary. (lit. Inexperienced persons welcome.)

examples.japanese: プログラミングは{未経験|みけいけん}ですが、{挑戦|ちょうせん}してみたいです。
examples.english: I have no programming experience, but I'd like to give it a try.

examples.japanese: {未経験|みけいけん}の{分野|ぶんや}に{飛|と}び{込|こ}むのは{不安|ふあん}もあるが、{新|あたら}しいことを{学|まな}ぶ{良|よ}い{機会|きかい}だ。
examples.english: Jumping into an unfamiliar field is nerve-wracking, but it's a good opportunity to learn new things.

notes:
USAGE:
{未経験|みけいけん} uses the prefix {未|み} (not yet), indicating a state of not having done something. Very commonly seen in job advertisements: {未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}{歓迎|かんげい} or {未経験|みけいけん}OK.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未経験者|みけいけんしゃ} (inexperienced person)
- {未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}{歓迎|かんげい} (no experience necessary)
- {業界|ぎょうかい}{未経験|みけいけん} (no industry experience)
- {未経験|みけいけん}から{始|はじ}める (to start with no experience)
